title: 第17章 计划出宗
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
他这是怎么了，为什么身上会这么痛，而且脸上还有肿痛感？

    这次发疯期间，到底发生了什么事？

    就在谢长泽困惑之际，林不语端着一碗黑乎乎的药水进来，想看看大师兄的情况。

    谁承想刚进门就发现被包得像木乃伊一样的大师兄正睁着充血的双眼，死死地瞪着自己，把他吓了一跳。

    “大师兄，你醒了啊！”

    这种场面经历了太多次，林不语缓过来后熟练地打招呼，很快就把谢长泽发疯期间干的蠢事说了一遍。

    “所以，我这是被小师妹身边的人打的？”

    谢长泽看到自己包得跟粽子一样的伤情，沉默了。

    “嗯，我听二师姐说你那时候非得往四师妹和五师妹那里闯，然后就这样了。”

    要林不语说，大师兄与其招惹小师妹，还不如继续被师父揍，至少挨揍痛快一点。

    不像小师妹那样钝刀子磨肉，最痛。

    “知道了，这都是我自找的。”

    谢长泽也痛恨自己一发疯就在宗门惹事的情况，现在师父不在，有小师妹压着也好，不过小师妹下手是真的挺痛的。

    微生璃月在剑峰待了一个月，除了日常在几位师兄那里刷刷装逼值，只偶尔去宗里看看，遇上特殊情况就揍揍发疯版大师兄。

    日子倒也平静，就是她现在在太虚宗里的名声太盛，根本没人敢招惹她，连男主叶不凡每次看到自己都躲得远远的。

    这一个月，除了几位师兄师姐贡献的装逼值多一点，其他人的贡献大大减少。

    总共累积下来，竟然才赚了8321点装逼值，都赶不上来太虚宗前两天的战绩，倒是装逼礼包存了不少，现在累积下来有11个还没开。

    “统子，按照剧情线，叶不凡接下来三个月都会苟在宗门里，直到升到筑基期后才会离开太虚宗开启修仙界四处闯荡的旅程。我们最近一个装逼任务，也是在三个月后的青虚秘境，要不然这段时间我们去其他地方看看？”

    装逼又不规定只能在一个地方装，现在太虚宗能获得的装逼值少了，那她去别的地方装不就得了。
content_en:
What's wrong with him? Why is he in so much pain and why is there swelling and pain on his face?

What happened during this madness?

Just when Xie Changze was confused, Lin Buyu came in with a bowl of dark potion, wanting to see how his senior brother was doing.

Who would have thought that as soon as he entered the door, he would find the senior brother wrapped like a mummy staring at him with bloodshot eyes, which shocked him.

"Elder brother, you're awake!"

Having experienced this kind of scene too many times, Lin Buyu greeted him skillfully after he recovered, and soon told him all the stupid things Xie Changze had done when he was crazy.

"So, I was beaten by someone close to my junior sister?"

Xie Changze fell silent when he saw his injuries wrapped up like rice dumplings.

"Well, I heard from Second Senior Sister that you had to go to Fourth Junior Sister and Fifth Junior Sister at that time, and that was it."

Lin Buyu said that instead of provoking the younger junior sister, it would be better for the senior brother to continue to be beaten by the master, at least the beating would be more satisfying.

It's not like the little junior sister who uses a dull knife to grind the flesh, which is the most painful.

"I know, I brought this on myself."

Xie Changze also hated the fact that he would cause trouble in the sect whenever he went crazy. Now that the master is away, it would be fine if the junior sister is there to suppress him, but it is really painful for the junior sister to do it.

Weisheng Liyue stayed in Jianfeng for a month. In addition to daily brushing up on pretentiousness with several senior brothers, she only occasionally visited the sect and beat up the crazy version of senior senior brother in special circumstances.

Life was peaceful, but her reputation in Taixu Sect was so great that no one dared to provoke her. Even the male protagonist Ye Bufan stayed away every time he saw her.

This month, except for a few senior brothers and sisters who contributed a little more pretense value, the contributions of others were greatly reduced.

In total, I have only earned 8321 points of pretense points, which is not even close to the performance of Taixu Sect in the previous two days. However, I have saved a lot of pretense gift packs, and now I have 11 points that have not yet been opened.

"Tongzi, according to the plot line, Ye Bufan will stay in the sect for the next three months, and will not leave Taixu Sect until he reaches the foundation building stage to start a journey of traveling around the world of immortality. Our latest pretense mission is also in the Qingxu Secret Realm three months later. How about we go to other places during this time?"

There is no rule that pretentiousness can only be done in one place. Now that Taixu Sect can get less pretentiousness points, she has to go somewhere else to pretend.
